sampling: Each budget epoch draws 4755 questions in identical batch sizes (18*256+147). BCE-all uses a new full permutation. Other objectives cycle through independently shuffled mixed-only pools, retaining unused entries across epochs. No candidate-level sampling; each question has equal weight. Shared sampler seed across objectives.
normalization: Mean/std of ALL train embeddings; identical to previous experiment. No question features.
checkpoint_selection: Highest official validation correct count, then lowest own objective validation loss, then earliest budget epoch. BCE-all loss uses all validation questions; other losses use mixed validation questions.
learning_rate_selection: Seed 17: highest official validation correct count, then lowest own objective validation loss; exact ties prefer first listed LR. Same two LR budget for every cell.
final_selection: Highest five-seed mean official validation accuracy, tie lower parameter count, then protocol order. Fixed seed 17, no ensemble.
primary_comparisons: Within each architecture: bce_mixed - bce_all; pairwise - bce_mixed; set_mass - bce_mixed. Within each objective: attention - independent.
uncertainty: Descriptive paired question bootstrap over seed-mean correctness, 10000 resamples; exploratory intervals conditional on this reused validation split, no multiple-comparison adjustment. Also report five seed paired differences. Do not pool seed-question pairs as independent observations.
test_policy: No test predictions, training, selection or scores. Official checker may check test integrity only.
